endpoint.description: Registry endpoint for pushing and pulling images For local registry: "host.k3d.internal:10082" For external registry with baseDomain: automatically uses "registry.<baseDomain>"
endpoint.title: endpoint

workflowNamespace.description: Namespace OpenChoreo runs this environment's Argo workflows in. The evaluation job namespace is derived from it as "workflows-<value>".
workflowNamespace.title: workflowNamespace

image.description: Docker image configuration for monitor evaluation

repository.description: Image repository For local development: will be pushed to local registry For production: ghcr.io/wso2/amp-evaluation-monitor
repository.title: repository

tag.description: Image tag IMPORTANT: For production, this should match the amp-evaluation SDK version used in dbMigration.evaluatorGenerator.image.tag in the wso2-agent-manager chart. Example: If using amp-evaluation==0.1.5, set this to "0.1.5"
tag.title: tag

image.title: image

useLocalRegistry.description: Whether to use local registry or external image When true, image will be prefixed with registry endpoint When false, uses repository:tag directly (for k3d imported images or external registries)
useLocalRegistry.title: useLocalRegistry

tracesApiEndpoint.description: In-cluster URL for the observer API
tracesApiEndpoint.title: tracesApiEndpoint

publisher.description: Publisher settings (for publishing evaluation scores to agent-manager)

endpoint.description: In-cluster URL for the agent-manager API
endpoint.title: endpoint

idpTokenUrl.description: OAuth2 client credentials for publisher authentication The evaluation job uses these to obtain a Bearer token from Thunder Note: clientSecret is loaded dynamically from OpenBao via ExternalSecret at workflow runtime
idpTokenUrl.title: idpTokenUrl

clientId.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID the job uses to obtain a publisher token.
clientId.title: clientId

publisher.title: publisher

networkPolicy.description: Restricts the evaluation-job pod's egress (untrusted, user-submitted code) to just DNS, the traces observer, Thunder, the agent-manager-service publisher endpoint, and the LLM gateway.

evaluationJob.description: Egress allow-list for the evaluation job, which executes user-submitted evaluator code.

enabled.description: No-op on clusters whose CNI doesn't enforce NetworkPolicy (e.g. plain flannel).
enabled.title: enabled

namespace.description: Empty derives "workflows-<ampEvaluation.workflowNamespace>" (where OpenChoreo runs this environment's Argo workflows), not this chart's own release namespace.
namespace.title: namespace

dns.description: DNS target on port 53, scoped rather than left wide open since this pod runs untrusted code.

namespace.description: Namespace running the cluster DNS pods.
namespace.title: namespace

podLabel.description: Label selecting the DNS pods, rather than opening port 53 cluster-wide.

key.description: Label key on the DNS pods.
key.title: key

value.description: Label value on the DNS pods.
value.title: value

podLabel.title: podLabel

dns.title: dns

observer.description: Ports are matched post-DNAT, so each is the target's containerPort, not its Service port.

ports.description: Ports the job may reach on the observer pods.
ports.title: ports

observer.title: observer

publisher.description: Agent Manager service the job publishes scores to.

namespace.description: Namespace running the Agent Manager service.
namespace.title: namespace

ports.description: Ports the job may reach on the Agent Manager service. Allowed values: amp-api's containerPort; its Service port 9000 never survives DNAT.
ports.title: ports

publisher.title: publisher

idp.description: Identity provider the job requests a token from.

ports.description: Ports the job may reach on the identity provider.
ports.title: ports

idp.title: idp

llmGateway.description: AI Gateway that LLM-judge evaluators call through.

ports.description: Ports the job may reach on the gateway.
ports.title: ports

namespace.description: Namespace holding the API Platform Gateway, allowed in addition to any namespace labelled amp.wso2.com/api-platform-gateway=true. That label is only applied by setup-gateway.sh and add-environment.sh, so an install that follows the gateway chart's own apiGateway.namespace default (openchoreo-data-plane) has no matching namespace and llm_judge evaluators are silently denied egress to the gateway. Empty = rely on the label alone.
namespace.title: namespace

llmGateway.title: llmGateway

devEgress.description: Local-dev only: ipBlock exception for the node network, covering agent-manager-service outside the cluster (8080) and the gateway's node port (19080). Empty (no-op) elsewhere; setup-amp-extensions.sh sets both.

cidr.description: Node network CIDR to allow. Empty disables the exception.
cidr.title: cidr

ports.description: Ports allowed on the node network.
ports.title: ports

devEgress.title: devEgress

apiServer.description: Node network of the kube-apiserver. Permissive default spans the pod and service CIDRs so any cluster works unconfigured; narrow to the control-plane subnet in production.

cidrs.description: Private ranges the API server may live in.
cidrs.title: cidrs

ports.description: Ports the API server listens on.
ports.title: ports

apiServer.title: apiServer

evaluationJob.title: evaluationJob

networkPolicy.title: networkPolicy
